prompt: In a flat vector illustration, a golden wheat field stretches across the background under a clear blue sky. On the far left stands a farmer in a red scarf holding a wooden pitchfork upright. Next to him sits a brown dog with floppy ears, its tail wagging slightly. In the center foreground, a woman in a yellow sunhat bends over to tie a bundle of wheat stalks. Beside her, a small child in blue overalls points excitedly at a large orange pumpkin resting on the ground. To the right of the pumpkin, an old man in suspenders leans against a rustic wooden fence post, watching the scene with a gentle smile. Perched atop the fence is a black crow looking down at the harvest activities below. Behind the fence, a white horse with a dark mane grazes peacefully on the grass. Near the horse, a metal bucket lies tipped over on its side. A basket woven from straw sits next to the woman in the yellow sunhat, filled with harvested grain. The farmer in the red scarf looks toward the woman tying the wheat. The brown dog sits next to the farmer's boots. The child in blue overalls points at the orange pumpkin. The old man in suspenders looks at the black crow. There is no machinery or modern equipment visible in the scene. There is no rain or cloudy weather depicted in the sky.
